proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We were building on rocky ground outside Nixa and dreaded the basement dig. Boone flagged where the house would sit, told us what rock would cost, then hit a ledge on day two. The price matched what he wrote down.
reviews.name: Callie W.
Gerald O.
reviews.text: Needed a trench for power out to my shop, about 140 feet. They waited for the locate flags, dug it straight and put the sod strips back on top. You can barely tell.

reviews.name: Annette P.
reviews.text: Every spring the backyard drained toward our foundation. They regraded it so it falls away, laid straw and seed, and came back to look after the first big storm. Crawlspace has stayed dry since.

reviews.name: Marty K.
reviews.text: Clear explanation of every step, written down. The drain runs along the fence and empties into the ditch by the road. Wet corner is now mowable.

reviews.name: Yolanda F.
reviews.text: Our wall builder said the base they cut and packed was one of the cleanest he'd been handed. The crew laid plywood over the lawn so the machine didn't rut it on the way back.

reviews.name: Dwight E.
reviews.text: Three stumps and a buried slab from an old shed. Half a day by the hour, done before lunch, hole filled and raked smooth. Billed what they said.

proof.guarantee: If a backfilled trench or regraded area settles in the first year, we come back and fix it.
